chapterInfo.content:
10
Nyansa ho mmɛ ahodoɔ
1Nwansena funu ma odufrani aduro bɔn na ɛporɔ,
na nkwaseasɛm kakra yɛ duru sene nyansa ne animuonyam.
2Onyansafoɔ akoma wɔ ne nifa mu,
na ɔkwasea akoma wɔ ne benkum mu.
3Nanso ɔkwan biara a ɔkwasea fa soɔ no, nteaseɛ bɔ no,
na ɔka kyerɛ nnipa nyinaa sɛ ɔyɛ ɔkwasea.
4 # Dwom 37.1; Mmb 24.19 Sɛ otumfoɔ honhom sɔre tia wo a,
nnya w’afa, na ɛdwo brɛ bɔne akɛseɛ ano ase.
5Adebɔne bi wɔ hɔ a mehunuu no owia aseɛ sɛ mfomsoɔ bi a ɛfiri otumfoɔ anim, 6#Mmb 30.21-22 wɔama nkwaseafoɔ so bebree, na adefoɔ tete fam. 7Mahunu nkoa a wɔtete apɔnkɔ soɔ ne adehyeɛ a wɔnenam fam sɛ nkoa.
8 # Mmb 26.27 Deɛ ɔtu amena no, emu na ɔbɛhweɛ,
na deɛ ɔburi ban no, ɔwɔ bɛka no.
9Deɛ ɔtu aboɔ no, ɛbɛhyɛ no yea,
na deɛ ɔpae nnua no, emu na ɔbɛpira.
10Sɛ obi dadeɛ ano akum na wanse ano a,
ɛnneɛ gye sɛ ɔma ahoɔden dɔɔso,
na mfasoɔ a wɔde di yie ne nyansa.
11 # Dwom 58.4-5 Sɛ ɔwɔ ka ansa na wɔakyekyere no nkaberɛ a,
na mfasoɔ biara nni hɔ mma nkaberɛkyekyerefoɔ.
12Onyansafoɔ anomu asɛm yɛ nyam,
na ɔkwasea ano bɛmene no.
13N’anomu asɛm mfitiaseɛ yɛ nkwaseasɛm,
na ne kasa awieeɛ yɛ adammɔ bɔne.
14 # Skf 5.3; 8.7 Ɔkwasea nso ma nsɛm dɔɔso.
Onipa nnim deɛ ɛreba,
na deɛ ɛbɛba n’akyire no, hwan na ɔbɛkyerɛ no?
15Nkwaseafoɔ haw hyɛ deɛ ɔnnim kuro mu korɔ brɛ.
16 # Yes 3.4 Due, wo asase a wo hene yɛ abɔfra,
na wo mmapɔmma to pono anɔpa.
17Nhyira ne wo, O asase a wo hene yɛ adehyeɛ ba,
na wo mmapɔmma to pono berɛ a ɛsɛ mu,
ahoɔden nti, na ɛnyɛ nsaborɔ nti.
18 # Mmb 19.15 Akwadworɔ nti na mpuna hwinhwan,
na aniha ma ɛdan nwunu.
19 # Ate 9.13; Dwom 104.15 Sereɛ nti na wɔsiesie aduane,
na nsa ma ateasefoɔ anigyeɛ,
na sika na ɛyɛ adeɛ nyinaa.
20 # Eks 22.28 Nnome ɔhene w’adwene mu mpo,
na nnome ɔdefoɔ wo dabekyire,
na ewiem nnomaa bi de nne no bɛkɔ,
na ntakraboa bi mpo aka asɛm no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nwansena funu ma odufrani aduro bɔn na ɛporɔ,
na nkwaseasɛm kakra yɛ duru sene nyansa ne animuonyam.
Onyansafoɔ akoma wɔ ne nifa mu,
na ɔkwasea akoma wɔ ne benkum mu.
Nanso ɔkwan biara a ɔkwasea fa soɔ no, nteaseɛ bɔ no,
na ɔka kyerɛ nnipa nyinaa sɛ ɔyɛ ɔkwasea.
Sɛ otumfoɔ honhom sɔre tia wo a,
nnya w’afa, na ɛdwo brɛ bɔne akɛseɛ ano ase.
Adebɔne bi wɔ hɔ a mehunuu no owia aseɛ sɛ mfomsoɔ bi a ɛfiri otumfoɔ anim, wɔama nkwaseafoɔ so bebree, na adefoɔ tete fam. Mahunu nkoa a wɔtete apɔnkɔ soɔ ne adehyeɛ a wɔnenam fam sɛ nkoa.
Deɛ ɔtu amena no, emu na ɔbɛhweɛ,
na deɛ ɔburi ban no, ɔwɔ bɛka no.
Deɛ ɔtu aboɔ no, ɛbɛhyɛ no yea,
na deɛ ɔpae nnua no, emu na ɔbɛpira.
Sɛ obi dadeɛ ano akum na wanse ano a,
ɛnneɛ gye sɛ ɔma ahoɔden dɔɔso,
na mfasoɔ a wɔde di yie ne nyansa.
Sɛ ɔwɔ ka ansa na wɔakyekyere no nkaberɛ a,
na mfasoɔ biara nni hɔ mma nkaberɛkyekyerefoɔ.
Onyansafoɔ anomu asɛm yɛ nyam,
na ɔkwasea ano bɛmene no.
N’anomu asɛm mfitiaseɛ yɛ nkwaseasɛm,
na ne kasa awieeɛ yɛ adammɔ bɔne.
Ɔkwasea nso ma nsɛm dɔɔso.
Onipa nnim deɛ ɛreba,
na deɛ ɛbɛba n’akyire no, hwan na ɔbɛkyerɛ no?
Nkwaseafoɔ haw hyɛ deɛ ɔnnim kuro mu korɔ brɛ.
Due, wo asase a wo hene yɛ abɔfra,
na wo mmapɔmma to pono anɔpa.
Nhyira ne wo, O asase a wo hene yɛ adehyeɛ ba,
na wo mmapɔmma to pono berɛ a ɛsɛ mu,
ahoɔden nti, na ɛnyɛ nsaborɔ nti.
Akwadworɔ nti na mpuna hwinhwan,
na aniha ma ɛdan nwunu.
Sereɛ nti na wɔsiesie aduane,
na nsa ma ateasefoɔ anigyeɛ,
na sika na ɛyɛ adeɛ nyinaa.
Nnome ɔhene w’adwene mu mpo,
na nnome ɔdefoɔ wo dabekyire,
na ewiem nnomaa bi de nne no bɛkɔ,
na ntakraboa bi mpo aka asɛm no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
